summary: Picard Medical filed an 8-K/A to correct a press release previously furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The original 8-K announced availability of a pre-recorded presentation for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign is disclosed. The filing merely amends a routine shareholder presentation and corrects a clerical error. Therefore, this is a routine current report amendment with no special-situation content.
